name: A Dress From Morgan
source:
Jace has a secret: he secretly likes crossdressing. He wants to tell the woman he's been dating, Morgan, about it, but is afraid she will reject him over it. Will he tell her the truth?

[From [url=https://librelizzy.itch.io/a-dress-from-morgan]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
杰斯有一个秘密：他偷偷喜欢变装。他想告诉他正在约会的女人摩根这件事，但担心她会因此拒绝他。他会告诉她真相吗？

[来自[url=https://librelizzy.itch.io/a-dress-from-morgan]itch.io[/url]]
